question: Which of the following states has the largest legislative assembly (in terms of number of members) in the country as on 30th September 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has the largest legislative assembly in India with a total of **403 members**.
 
• The legislative assembly of Uttar Pradesh is known as the **Vidhan Sabha**.
 
• The state is divided into **403 Vidhan Sabha constituencies** from where the members are elected.
 
• The **Vidhan Sabha** meets at the **Vidhan Bhavan** in Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India, which necessitates a larger legislative body to represent its diverse population.
 
• The **Governor of Uttar Pradesh** is the nominal head of the state, while the **Chief Minister** is the head of government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan**__

 __
 
• Rajasthan has a legislative assembly with **200 members**.
 
• The assembly is known as the **Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha**.
 
• The legislative assembly is located in Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 __
 
• The Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly consists of **234 members**.
 
• The assembly meets at the **Fort St. George** complex in Chennai, the capital of Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 
 
• The legislative assembly of Madhya Pradesh has **230 members**.
 
• The assembly is known as the **Madhya Pradesh Vidhan Sabha**.
 
• The legislative assembly is located in Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh.
